div.p: Many plant species and groups mentioned in the Delaware Wildlife Action Plan, primarily in the Chapter 2 habitat descriptions, are referred to in the text by common name only. The following table provides the scientific names for these plant taxa. This list is provided here for reference and is not indicative of the status or proposed status of the taxa listed.
